comments.author: @helpimarock66
comments.text: I absolutely love super jail! It's such a shame the seasons take so long to produce, but hey, that makes is all the more sweet when they finally premier! The first season was by far the best, so much gore and craziness! The second season was good, but not great (they got a better animation team and showcased the new animation more than going bat-shit insane like they usually do). The third season picked up again when they decided to go back to their roots and it got just as (if not, more) insane as the first season, but my one complaint is that it needed more twins (you can never have enough twins). So as you can tell, I am really, really stoked for this!!
